title: Mexican coleslaw
instructions: Prep all ingredients for Mexican coleslaw: 6-7 cups slaw mix, 1/3 cup lime juice, 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin, 1 teaspoon honey.
Cook and assemble according to the doc method: 6-7 cups slaw mix 1/3 cup lime juice 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 1 teaspoon honey 2 cloves garlic minced sprinkle of salt and pepper 1/2 cup olive oil.
Adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and acidity to taste and serve hot.
notes: Original Doc Shorthand: 6-7 cups slaw mix — 1/3 cup lime juice — 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin — 1 teaspoon honey — 2 cloves garlic minced — sprinkle of salt and pepper — 1/2 cup olive oil
